name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.34.3: Close the four truncation sites the device build reports.
changelog.v2.34.2: Stop input-map leaking readers, and hold a held button together; Stop the power button quitting the client.
changelog.v2.34.1: Stop scanning while a link is up or being made.
changelog.v2.34.0: Say what a fix is, how precise, and whose clock dated it; Check the conversion before the coordinate, and don't date a replayed fix by unrelated chatter.
changelog.v2.33.1: Retry a timed-out ServicesResolved poll instead of ending the link; Return from the event loop within its own timeout.
